title: Functions in $L_1(μ,Y)$ with optimal tensor representations
summary: We study the existence and characterization of optimal tensor representations of elements in the space $L_1(μ,Y)$ of Bochner integrable functions. We completely describe the set of norm-attaining elements in two settings. First, when the Banach space $Y$ is strictly convex, and second, when $Y=L_1(ν)$ and $\mathbb K=\mathbb R$. In both situations, our analysis yields the existence of non-norm-attaining tensors whenever the underlying measures are not purely atomic. Finally, we introduce a geometric property over $Y$ ensuring that every element in $L_1(μ, Y)$ admits an optimal representation.…
